title: Fake Conference Acceptance
scenario: A conference says your abstract was accepted and registration must be paid today.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Fake Conference Acceptance: the trap is to make speed feel safer than verification. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Check conference legitimacy, organizer, and official domain.
